Can you picture yourself working in a massive clothing warehouse? At our client in Bleiswijk, you can! Get started as an order picker and earn an hourly wage of €14.99, which with allowances can increase up to €18.73 per hour. Want to start quickly? No problem! Apply directly and see your first paycheck in your bank account as soon as next week! 💸

What we offer
- An hourly salary of €14,99 gross per hour
- Travel allowance: > 10 km
- Working in the latest clothing and fashion world!
- Chance of a permanent contract after 7 months!
- € 18.73 gross per hour after 19:00
- Full-time work in 2 or 3 shifts!

Who you are
Are you the order picker we are looking for? Check it here:

- You are available 5 days per week on a flexible basis, in any case on Sundays and Mondays.
- You work in at least 2 shifts (night shifts are mandatory).
- You have a good command of the English language, both spoken and written.
- You can easily commute to our location in Bleiswijk.
- You have your own transport to travel to the location.

What will you do
Thousands of online orders flow in daily, and as an order picker, you ensure that every parcel is correct! 🛍️ With scanner in hand, you gather the trendiest fashion items across the huge warehouse: from the latest sneakers to stylish coats. Have you completed your picking list? Then you take the items to the packing department and immediately start the next round. Thanks to the active and varied work environment, your workday will fly by! 🚀

Work hours (3 shifts):

- 🌅 Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:30
- 🌆 Afternoon/evening shift: 14:30 – 23:30
- 🌙 Night shift: 22:00 – 06:00

Where will you work
You will be working at a leading logistics service provider in Bleiswijk that handles the complete logistics operation for a major online fashion retailer. As an order picker, you work daily with the newest clothing collections. You will do this in a dynamic and international team

jobs.description:
Ready for a fresh start with great benefits? 🌟 Come work as a Production worker at Elis in Bolsward! You will earn a sparkling salary between € 15.57 and € 16.02 per hour! Add some amazing evening allowances up to 45%, free warm dinners, and a super fun team, and you have found your perfect job! 💸✨ Read on and discover why this is the place to be! 🎉

What we offer
- Salary between € 15.57 and € 16.02 per hour!
- Free dinner during evening shifts!
- Allowances up to 45% extra on your salary!
- A nice travel allowance!
- Growth opportunities and a fixed contract!
- You are free every weekend!

Who you are
To keep the production running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- 🗣️ You speak excellent English AND you already understand basic Dutch (and are eager to learn more!).
- 🗓️ You have flexible availability, between 24 and 36 hours a week.
- ⏰ You can work shifts from Monday to Friday (being available on Friday is a must!).
- 🏢 You have your own housing in the Bolsward area.
- 🚗 You have your own transportation to Bolsward.
- 💪 You are comfortable with physical work, like standing during your shift.
- 🥼 You are willing to follow strict hygiene rules (no makeup, jewelry, fake nails, or eyelashes allowed).

What will you do
As a Production worker, no two days are the same! 👕 You might start in the sorting department, carefully checking incoming items from hospitals and pharmacies for any lost objects like pens. 🕵️ Or maybe you will shine in the cleanroom or packing department, carefully folding and preparing sterile clothing for transport! Because you might rotate tasks or focus on one specialty line, the work stays engaging and fun! 🏃 Working here means being active, meaning you can easily skip the gym! 💪 And the best part? You are doing incredibly important work, ensuring healthcare professionals always have clean and safe gear. 🦸

Where will you work
Elis in Bolsward is not just any workplace; it is the only location
